registryBasis: The city’s official Filipeia atlas publishes a municipal Lotes layer and advertises a citywide shape/CSV download. The linked archive was inaccessible by anonymous HTTPS (403), so no public geometry or schema was verified.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
technicalBlocker: The municipal Filipeia atlas identifies an official Lotes layer and advertises a shapefile/CSV download (188,703 lots). The official download link returned HTTP 403 to an anonymous range request; the map page also could not be fetched directly from the shell. The public service charter describes property-related applications as login/identity workflows, which were not accessed. No schema, anonymous feature route, or target geometry was verified.
scopeLimits: Municipal parcel layer existence is verified, but the actual archive and feature geometry were inaccessible. Atlas service includes tax inscription UI and login-based property workflows; no such lookups were made.
remainingUncertainty: A public feature geometry response and exact point parcel coverage remain unverified.
